technical_rules: Use tabular-nums class for all prices and quantities.
Left-align tabular data unless specific metric requires right-alignment.

rules: Never use pure black or pure white; tint neutrals.
Use #16A34A (Green) specifically for the final 'Bayar' button.
Use 1px borders instead of soft shadows for structural containers.

pos_checkout.product_area: lg:col-span-8 flex flex-col h-full bg-zinc-50 p-6 overflow-y-auto
pos_checkout.cart_panel: lg:col-span-4 h-full bg-white border-l border-zinc-200 flex flex-col shadow-[-4px_0_24px_rgba(0,0,0,0.02)]

layouts.dashboard_reports: Dense Grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 p-8
layouts.spacing_strategy: Generous inside containers (p-6, p-8) to prevent text collision, tight gap (gap-4) between data widgets.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Grid Borders (Technical Look). Expose the skeleton for the POS grid.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid border-zinc-200 on cards instead of heavy drop shadows.
visual_enhancers.hover_states: Crisp transformations: -translate-y-1 with subtle shadow-md and explicit text color change.
visual_enhancers.modals: Solid backgrounds (bg-white) with 1px border. NO Glassmorphism for POS.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped or slightly rounded (rounded-md). High contrast text.
components.cards: Cardless, flat, rectangular, dense styles. max 8px border-radius.
components.forms: Shadcn UI base heavily customized. No native inputs. Stack fields vertically.
components.data_tables: Shadcn UI Tables for Inventory/Suppliers. Dense rows, distinct headers.

grids.product_grid: grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4 gap-4 items-stretch

motion.transitions: Use specific properties: transition-transform duration-200 ease-out. NO transition-all.
motion.lists: Staggered entrance for product grid items.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure min 4.5:1 ratio for standard text.
accessibility.focus: High contrast focus rings: focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500 focus:ring-offset-2
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid.

media.image_constraints: Product images must have explicit aspect ratios (aspect-square) with object-cover.

3d_libraries.usage: NOT RECOMMENDED for this POS. Focus on 2D speed and clarity.

instructions_to_main_agent: Language MUST be Indonesian (Bahasa Indonesia) for all labels, placeholders, and feedback messages (e.g., 'Keranjang', 'Bayar', 'Total', 'Tunai', 'Stok', 'Laporan').
Implement two distinct roles via JWT: Admin (access to all pages including dashboard/inventory/suppliers) and Kasir (access to POS checkout, transactions, receipt).

Receipt handling (Struk): Implement a modal for viewing the receipt. Provide buttons for 'Cetak' (browser window.print() triggered on a @media print optimized component) and 'Kirim WA/Email' (mocked API call visually showing success).
Payment integration: Include buttons for 'Tunai' (Cash), 'QRIS', and 'Kartu' (Card). For Cash, implement a quick change calculator (Kembalian).
Do NOT use HTML <select> or native inputs. Use Shadcn UI dropdowns, dialogs, and inputs.
Do NOT center align the app container. No .App { text-align: center; }.
POS layout MUST prioritize desktop screens with an ever-present cart on the right side.
Ensure all interactive buttons use the data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='checkout-button').
Use Sonner for toasts via Shadcn.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid generic 'AI slop' aesthetics. No uniform gradients or basic centered layouts.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy, but keep POS flat and readable.
Avoid universal transitions (no 'transition: all'). Use specific property transitions.
Never use purely transparent backgrounds on overlays or dropdowns. Always use solid bg with 1px border for data apps.
Always use modern button styles (pill-shaped or rounded-md with crisp hover state).
NEVER use emojis (🤖🧠💭) for icons. Always use proper SVG icons.
Use 2-3x more spacing (p-6, p-8) inside major layout containers.
Prioritize using pre-existing Shadcn components from src/components/ui.
Examine existing components to understand project patterns before creating new ones.
